same_settings_baseline.note: No improvement. The ASSERT-pool filter did not fix any of the 14 named wrong-element picks; the same wrong locators persist (eval-002/006 `.modal-title.w-100`, eval-003 `h1.text-center`, eval-005 `#dob`/`#quoteSubmit`, eval-010 `#order-error`, eval-001 inventory URL). The total fell by 1 placeholder (94 -> 93): eval-004 gained 1 (the known flaky story, 4/7 -> 5/7), eval-005 lost 1 (new weakened_to_visible_element on `quote reference number`), eval-008 lost 1 (`payment success message` -> `#accounts-list`). Within the same-settings band (89-94/113) this is draw jitter, not a code effect. The filter is not the lever; the wrong picks are made before/outside the ASSERT semantic pool (page-context and FILL/CLICK paths) or the target never enters the pool.

flaky_story.note: eval-004's external site is slow and flaky. Across eight held-out runs (t-0534 to t-0814) generation took 253.1s at fastest and 621.7s at slowest, and eval-004's own score was 3/7, 1/7, 4/7, 1/7, 4/7, 4/7, 4/7, 5/7 - it moves with the draw. The 2026-10-13 gate1-filter run scored it 5/7. eval-004's per-story number is not repeatable, so read a gate run with that in mind: do not treat an eval-004 delta as a like-for-like movement, and prefer the overall figure over that story's number - remembering that the overall figure's own jitter is this one story.
